_README: Copy to config.json to override defaults. mainnetEnabled ONLY takes effect when legalReview.completed=true (see README). Keep it false until an operator records a completed legal/compliance review.

legalReview.note: Operator must obtain legal/compliance sign-off before enabling mainnet.

seed._README: #37 listing liquidity seed. On activation the protocol seeds the new asset's BLOCK market with seedBlockUsd of BLOCK FROM THE PREMINE/RESERVE — IN ADDITION to the listing fee. Testnet default: dryRun (intent recorded, nothing sent). A real mainnet dispense requires mainnetEnabled AND a reachable non-relay signerUrl; otherwise it FAILS CLOSED (the listing is not activated). The relay holds NO reserve key.

htlc._README: DEPLOYED HTLC addresses the relay settles each swap leg against. The relay holds NO keys; these are PUBLIC contract/program/package ids each party's wallet calls. The swap engine REFUSES (fail-closed) any leg whose address is unset for the active network. Mainnet keys (evm.base, evm.ethereum, solana.mainnet, sui.mainnet) are only consulted when mainnetEnabled=true, so leaving them blank keeps a testnet deployment testnet-only. Fill these from each leg's deploy script output: evm → scripts/deploy.js 'HTLC deployed at'; solana → anchor program id; sui → published packageId; block → 'blockle-chain contract deploy' contract id. Env overrides: BLOCKLE_EXCHANGE_HTLC_BTC_ESPLORA, BLOCKLE_EXCHANGE_HTLC_BTC_HOTWALLET, BLOCKLE_EXCHANGE_HTLC_BLOCK_CONTRACT.
